Synopsis:
One of a pair of Zhentarim agents trapped in a cave by gnolls. A veteran mercenary, tough, and above all else a survivor. The rest of their crew are dead. Rugan here is the senior agent of the two, and he's grimly determined to survive this terrible situation.

Cluster Contexts:
- PLA_ZhentShipment_Agent_001_Cave.json: Rugan and one other Zhentarim agent are holed up in a cave entrance while a pack of gnolls pins them in; the rest of their crew were killed before these moments. Rugan is the senior, veteran mercenary — grim, pragmatic, and focused on survival — and is pushing immediate, violent action because the gnolls are close and desperate. He’s already using improvised incendiaries to hold the beasts back and is shouting for help and coordination rather than hesitation. The player is present as the nearby ally the pair can rely on, and Rugan expects them to act to deal with the gnolls so they can escape.

context: Rugan and one other Zhentarim agent are holed up at a cave entrance with a pack of gnolls pressing them; the rest of their crew were killed before these moments. Rugan is the senior, veteran mercenary — grim, pragmatic, and focused on survival — and is already using improvised incendiaries to hold the beasts back. He’s urgent and short-tempered, demanding immediate, violent action and expecting the nearby player ally to engage the gnolls so they can escape. If things go poorly, later scenes treat him as badly wounded or even bound and barely able to speak.
